description: Legacy top-level lowercase contributing page (existed v0.16-v0.43). From v0.44-v0.51 its canonical home was developers-guide/contributing, so redirect that band straight there (single hop). Versions below v0.44 keep serving their own lowercase page.
Same legacy lowercase page, v0.52 onward: the canonical home became the top-level uppercase CONTRIBUTING, so redirect directly there (single hop, no chaining through developers-guide).

Legacy developers-guide location of the contributing page (existed v0.41-v0.51), superseded by the top-level uppercase CONTRIBUTING at v0.52. Redirect only versions where CONTRIBUTING exists so we never 301 into a 404; older versions keep serving developers-guide/contributing.
